$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Help and support

band.rule: Ritual and safety: never suppressed, P5.

job: Answers and a way to reach a person, from inside a service.
useFor: Help with a request or with the service.
notFor: Marketing content or FAQs that sell.

allowed: SectionTitle with Collapsed Section or DropdownItem lists, grouped by topic.
forbidden: Topics that end without an answer or a next step.
AI that issues religious rulings or invents service facts (M4).

allowed: One CTA to a person: chat, call or ticket.
forbidden: Burying contact behind the AI or behind several screens.

rules: Help sits in the same place on every screen (M10).
A person is always reachable; AI is one of the routes, not a gate.
Answers are short, with one next step.
An open ticket shows its state at the top.

allocation.Placement: Reachable within two taps from every screen, in every state. Nothing suppresses it: not ihram, not Arafah, not a payment flow.

measure.success: Time to first response and time to resolution

allocation.Service: Support Center · DNA Supportive · P5 permanent.

notes: Toolbar: The MarketPlace Landing type (deprecated; the flow uses it).
example.inTheFlowToday: Topic lists are a component named List Products.
